title: Ukwaphulwa Kwethemba Lokuqala EParadesi
intro: Khawucinge nje umi emyezweni woxolo olupheleleyo, uhlonitshwe ngaphezu kwayo yonke indalo, unomda omnye kuphela wokuhlonitshwa. Ilizwi eliphantsi lithembisa ubuphakade, ukhetho olunye lutshintsha yonke into, kodwa inceba ivula indlela yokubuyela umva. Ngubani othetha ukususela ekuqaleni koluntu?
clues: Ndadalwa nguAllah ngodongwe kwaye ndenziwe ngononophelo lukaThixo.
Ndazukiswa xa uAllah wayalela iingelosi ukuba ziqubude kum.
Ndahlala eParadesi nomyeni wam, ndikhululekile ukunandipha zonke izinto ngaphandle komthi omnye.
Ndakhohliswa kukusebeza kukaSathana owafunga ukuba ungumcebisi onyanisekileyo.
Nditye kumthi owalelweyo kwaye isigqubuthelo sam sasuswa ngenxa yeentloni.
Ndifunde amazwi okuguquka eNkosini yam, waza uAllah wajika wandinceda ngenceba.

trial.label: Uvavanyo/Isiganeko
options: Wenqaba ukungena kwiLizwe eliNgcwele ngenxa yokoyika
Ndatya kumthi owalelweyo emva kokuhleba kukaSathana
Baphikisana ngelithi izithixo zookhokho kufuneka zinqulwe
trial.answer: Ndatya kumthi owalelweyo emva kokuhleba kukaSathana

outcome.label: Isiphumo
options: UAllah undifundise amazwi okuguquka waza wandixolela
Ndabethwa ngumbane ngenxa yokufuna ukubona uAllah
Ndiginywe yintlanzi enkulu ngenxa yokumka ndinomsindo
Ndaguquka nabantu bam ngenxa yokwaphula iSabatha
outcome.answer: UAllah undifundise amazwi okuguquka waza wandixolela

arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَا ظَلَمْنَآ أَنفُسَنَا وَإِن لَّمْ تَغْفِرْ لَنَا وَتَرْحَمْنَا لَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: They said, "Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy upon us, we will surely be among the losers." (7:23)
